RevenueCat, measured

Every value on this page is a CSS custom property generated from tokens.json. Light is the public marketing site at www.revenuecat.com. Dark is the signed-out app at app.revenuecat.com, which was on screen with html.dark. The toggle sets data-mode on <html>. It does not recreate a marketing dark theme, because the marketing site had none.

Read on 2026-11-19 from computed styles. helveticaNeue, objectSans and Inter Variable are not loaded here, so type specimens use the system sans. The real pages are in screenshots/.

Colour

Light roles are the marketing site: page white, canvas gray-50, navy text, blue action. Dark roles are the signed-out app: surface #14161b, text #f2f3f5, blue link #606dff. Flip the header to compare. The two themes are two products, not one palette inverted.

Ramps

The marketing site names a short gray and status set. The signed-out app names ten-step --rc-* ramps. Both sit in core.color. Steps are the declared values, not a filled scale.

Typography

Marketing display is objectSans at 60px on the home h1, 56px on the section h2, 32px on a smaller section. Body is helveticaNeue at 16px. The app heading is ObjectSans at 24px / 700, and its fields are Inter Variable at 14px. Those faces are not loaded on this page.

Radius and size

The marketing radius scale runs from 0.125rem to 2rem. Pill buttons computed to the Tailwind rounded-full sentinel, recorded as 9999px on the component tokens.

Motion

The marketing site declares a 150ms default and a 300ms colour transition on nav links, both on cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1). Click a track to play the duration.

Components

Drawn from the measured control tokens. Light shows the marketing pill button and email field. Dark shows the app's disabled submit and 32px outlined field, which is what was on the login page.
